app.name: GardenPlan
app.tagline: Plan beds, track plantings and log every harvest

Productive in containers; harvest regularly to keep it fruiting.

personas.name: Garden owner
goals: Plan what goes in each bed
See what needs care today and how much I have harvested

assumptions: One person owns each garden; reminders go to the owner email stored on the garden
Helpers sign in with their own email; they share the owner's data
Outdoor and terrace gardens; no greenhouse climate control
Harvest quantities are recorded in kilograms
Expected harvest date is entered by the user, using the plant's days to harvest as a guide
Plants are a user-maintained catalogue; photos are optional
Email notifications only; no SMS or push
Area in square feet; English only

params.subject: Garden care due today: {task_type}
params.body: A {task_type} task for {planting.plant.common_name} in {planting.bed.name} is due today.

params.subject: Overdue: {task_type} for {planting.plant.common_name}
params.body: This {task_type} task was due on {due_date} and is still pending.

params.subject: {plant.common_name} harvest finished
params.body: {plant.common_name} in {bed.name} is fully harvested. Total yield: {total_harvested} kg.

requirements.text: Keep gardens and their beds, with bed type, soil and area
Maintain a plant catalogue with category, sun need, days to harvest and watering interval
Record plantings in beds and move each through planned, planted, harvested or failed
Log harvests by weight and show the total yield per planting
Schedule care tasks (water, fertilise, prune, weed, pest check), mark them done or skipped, and email reminders for tasks due or overdue
Show a dashboard of what is growing, care due today, overdue tasks and monthly harvest
Owners manage everything; helpers can log plantings, care and harvests but cannot delete records or change gardens, beds or the plant catalogue
